Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by inflation fears and rising Treasury yields. This is a headwind for growth/tech names like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL (-44.2%) and SPAL (-56.06%) are leveraged ETFs and look particularly vulnerable. QQQ (-4.04%) and QQQI (-6.31%) are also down. SMH (-11.01%) needs attention. CRWD (1.53%) and PTNM (-15.25%) are holding up better.

Watch: Keep an eye on that 5.2% Treasury yield – a move to 6% would be brutal.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech bets are bleeding, and the macro picture isn't helping.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming if it breaks below its current price. Leveraged ETFs decay.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, consider trimming if it falters. High risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch
